BiblicalUsage: Moqdah is the hearth, the place of burning — the burnt offering shall be on the hearth upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the all-night fire is the picture of a sacrifice that never stops: the altar burns while Israel sleeps.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
